EmailTemplate.name: GRAD - Question about general Graduate Advisors
EmailTemplate.subject: Finding your academic advisor at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Graduate Admission Services. We do not have any general advisors in our office. To identify your personal academic advisor, you will need to contact the academic department directly. Telephone numbers and email addresses are listed for each degree program in the academic catalog at https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/graduate/false?init=false&nopassive=true.
Thank you,
Graduate Admission Services
If you have any additional questions related to this, please reply to this email.
